task: find a recipe that matches specific constraints and save it (Allrecipes, Cookpad, Food Network Kitchen, Paprika, Pinterest recipes, NYT Cooking): search for a dish, apply the constraints that matter (dietary restriction like gluten-free/vegan, excluded ingredient, time limit, rating), open a matching recipe, check its ingredient list against the constraints, and save/bookmark it to a collection; complete when the saved state (recipe in favorites/collection) is on screen. Surface pinned: a recipe site or cooking app's search and save flow. Variants: actual cooking footage (kitchen videos) as the main subject, recipe-development/food-blogging business content, meal-kit unboxings, and "what I eat in a day" content do not belong.

tree.label: Find and use recipes
tree.note: do 1. 2 where the platform opens with a wizard (euaM, jdwE) - the rest never see one. 3 where a pantry exists: it can run before any search, and 4 can start from 3.3 (9ChE). repeat 4 and 5 per candidate - two keepers run 4 alone and never open a recipe (9ChE, RGkk). 6 per kept recipe, as often as the plan needs; 5 ends in 6, in 6.9, or in nothing. 7 once recipes are kept - 7.2 alone when the list derives from a single save (GNRC). 8 where the cooking happens in-app. 9 after every save and every derived artifact, not once at the end - uCtL runs it four times mid-task. one keeper is blocked twice inside 7.1.4 by an offline error and abandons (wnsH).

questions.question: Did the save button actually register your action, or did it fail silently without showing a confirmation message?
